description: Distill session lessons into a lean AGENTS.md (create or update), following the open agents.md spec: collect lessons, distill them into one-line rules, organically merge, verify every command, and write only after user approval. Adapts to coding and work (non-code collaboration directory) scenarios; syncs project memory and progress/status records; collects scattered docs and data (fixed buckets for coding, work-type-fitted taxonomy for work). Trigger on requests like "write the lessons into AGENTS.md", "solidify this session's pitfalls into project rules", "update project guidelines", "organize project docs and data" — 中文触发词：「总结经验/教训写进 AGENTS.md」「把这次踩的坑固化成项目规则」「更新项目规范」「整理项目文档与数据」「沉淀项目协作规范」「文档归档到 docs」。All file changes require user confirmation first.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
